'''Tephen''' "'''Tang'''" '''Hamilton''' (born May 26, 1978) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) for the [[Miami Heat]] during the [[2001–02 NBA season|2001–02 season]]. Hamilton played [[college basketball]] for the [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]].

==Life and career==

===Early life===
Born in [[Jackson, Mississippi]], Hamilton was named [[Mississippi Mr. Basketball]] during his senior season at [[Lanier High School (Jackson, Mississippi)|Lanier High School]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Thomas |first1=Chris |title=Past Mr. Basketball, boys Coach of the Year winners |url=https://www.clarionledger.com/story/prepsreport/2014/04/13/pastmrbasketball/7665707/ |website=Clarion Ledger |accessdate=July 29, 2020 |date=April 13, 2014}}</ref>

===NBA===
Hamilton played in the NBA from October 2001 to November 2001, appeared in nine games for the [[Miami Heat]], and averaged 2.2 points and 2.0 rebounds. His final game was on November 27, 2001, in a 83–84 loss to the [[Boston Celtics]] where he played for two minutes and recorded no stats outside of a missed three-pointer.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/h/hamilta01/gamelog/2002|title=Tang Hamilton 2001-02 Game Log|website=[[Basketball Reference]]|publisher=[[Sports Reference]]|accessdate=29 June 2022}}</ref>
